settingsFaqCapsuleAnswer: A photo with a title and a note, pinned on the map where you made it. You can set a date: until then the capsule stays locked.

@settingsFaqVisibilityAnswer.description: The words in brackets are the visibility options of a capsule (see the glossary).

settingsFaqFriendsAnswer: Search by username in Friends, scan their QR code, or share your profile link from your profile.
settingsFaqNotificationsAnswer: Check Settings > Notifications: the phone must allow Later to notify you, and push notifications must be on. Quiet hours and muted chats also keep pushes silent.
settingsFaqBlockQuestion: How do I stop someone contacting me?
settingsFaqBlockAnswer: Block them from their profile or from the chat menu. You can unblock them in Settings > Blocked users.
settingsFaqDeleteQuestion: How do I delete my account?
settingsFaqDeleteAnswer: Settings > Delete account. Everything you made is removed and cannot be brought back.
